title: Warmly Spiced American Chicken Skewers
description: Savory and tender, these American chicken skewers are a crowd-pleaser, featuring extra virgin olive oil and nuka-pickle for a Mediterranean-friendly flavor profile, all cooked to perfection in a bamboo steamer.
instructions: Preheat the bamboo steamer by filling the bottom with 2 inches of water and bringing to a boil.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, nuka-pickle, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the bamboo steamer, cover with a lid, and steam for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the steamer and brush with lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as roasted vegetables or quinoa.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
